description.en: The ID of the custom rule.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the Data Management center of threat analysis is located. Select the region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of the member that the administrator wants to impersonate to view data.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise.

description.zh: 模拟测试数据，只有在测试类型为simulate情况下赋值。
description.en: The simulated data for the test. This parameter is required only when TestType is set to simulate.

description.zh:
测试类型。取值：
- simulate：模拟数据测试
- business：业务数据测试
description.en:
The test type. Valid values:

- simulate: tests the rule with simulated data

- business: tests the rule with business data

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem post-customize-rule-test --id 123456789 --test-type simulate --simulated-data key1_:_value1_,_key2_:_value2_,_key3_:_value3_,_key4_:_value4_,_key5_:_value5 --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
